title: HS30088: Service Sector Economics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: None Course ContentsIntroduction - Nature, Characteristics and
Classification of services; Activities in the Service Sector; Estimating its
contribution to GDP in different Developed and Developing Countries, Output and
Productivity, Investment requirements; Employment generation; Pricing of
Services; Linkages to other sectors; Government policies towards service
sector; Reforms in the service sector; Service Marketing.
